title: REQ · Shell renders a full-viewport 80/20 layout with a mobile bottom drawer
summary: GameLayout uses Tailwind, the UI store and no page overflow
description: Context: GameLayout uses local state and min-height 100vh CSS grid, which can scroll the page. Desired behavior: root is h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden; desktop (md and up) grid columns 4fr/1fr with the story column scrolling independently; below md the story panel is a fixed bottom drawer driven by useUiStore.drawerOpen; the Story toggle and scene stay mounted. Why: no page scroll and reachable controls on mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Given GameLayout rendered, when inspected, then the root has overflow-hidden, h-screen and w-screen and the grid has md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr]
Given the Story button clicked, when the store is read, then drawerOpen toggles and aria-expanded matches while the scene stays mounted
Given the story aside, when inspected, then it has overflow-y-auto and exactly one .story-panel exists
Given drawerOpen true, when rendered, then only the aside has drawer-open
